# MedBay

> MedBay is an AES-256 encrypted family medical document vault and plain-English clinical AI hub. It helps individuals and family caregivers store medical records for up to five managed dependents, understand lab panels with verified WHO/NHS/CDC citations, chat over profile-isolated health records, and share time-limited raw documents with doctors in one click.

## Core Value Proposition

- **Family-Isolated Medical Vault:** Manage self, spouse, children, and aging parents under a single encrypted account with strict PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) isolation and zero separate logins for dependents.
- **Plain-English AI Clinical Summaries:** Upload multi-page PDFs, lab panels, scanned prescriptions, DOCX, or TXT files (up to 25 MB). MedBay extracts biomarkers, highlights normal/attention/critical flags, generates tailored questions for your physician, and cites authoritative medical sources (WHO, NHS, CDC, NIH, MedlinePlus, Mayo Clinic, Cleveland Clinic, MSD Manuals).
- **Profile-Isolated Clinical RAG Chat & Calendar Booking:** Ask questions strictly scoped to one family member's records at a time, and schedule doctor follow-ups directly onto Google Calendar from chat.
- **One-Click Expiring Doctor Share Links:** Generate 24-hour, 7-day, or 30-day zero-login share links that expose only the original medical file—never AI chat history, personal notes, or other family profiles—with instant one-tap revocation.
- **24-Hour Read-Only Gmail Scanner:** Automatically checks connected Gmail every 24 hours for new lab notices, prescriptions, and clinic updates via calm in-app and Web Push alerts.

## Target Audience

- Parents managing pediatric records, allergy plans, immunizations, and prescriptions for children.
- Caregivers coordinating lab results, hospital discharges, and specialist visits for aging parents.
- Individuals seeking calm, plain-English clinical explanations grounded in verified medical authorities rather than unverified search results.

- [How to read a metabolic blood panel before your follow up visit](https://www.medbayhealth.xyz/blog/how-to-read-your-blood-panel-without-panic): Calm four-layer framework for reviewing HbA1c, glucose, kidney eGFR, electrolytes, and liver enzymes.
- [Keeping medical records clear across children, parents, and yourself](https://www.medbayhealth.xyz/blog/organizing-medical-records-for-three-generations): Why database-enforced family profile isolation prevents dosage and record mix-ups.
- [Why expiring doctor share links beat forwarding medical PDFs](https://www.medbayhealth.xyz/blog/why-expiring-share-links-beat-emailing-medical-pdfs): Security benefits of time-boxed zero-login links with instant revocation.
